title: You Think Humans Hate Risk Equally, Yet One Minus Sign Turns Savers Into Gamblers
description:
You think smart adults judge money by pure math! Yet one minus sign turns savers into wild gamblers! This is the true story of Daniel Kahneman's Prospect Theory. Here is what went wrong with old economic rules.
